evals.prompt: I want to move the lintable rules of the vercel react best practices skill into ESLint. Skill is at <scratch>/upstream/agent-skills/skills/react-best-practices, name it vercel-react-best-practices, output into a fresh repo at <scratch>/out-1. Do steps 1 and 2 only (extraction and mapping), then stop at the second checkpoint with the status counts and covered list.
evals.expected_output: Rule count + 10-rule sample at checkpoint 1 (auto-continue allowed in the test), then status counts and a covered list where every rule ID was verified against an installed plugin; no fork yet.
assertions: Reports the rule count and a 10-rule sample
Reports counts per status and a full covered list with plugin rule IDs
Every covered rule ID exists in an installed plugin (script check)
Does not create a skills/ fork yet
Mapping JSON has all required fields for every rule

evals.prompt: Run the whole split on the vercel react-best-practices skill (<scratch>/upstream/agent-skills/skills/react-best-practices, name vercel-react-best-practices) into <scratch>/out-2. I approve the granularity and the mapping as long as every covered rule was actually verified; continue through fork, lint config and docs, then give me the final summary.
evals.expected_output: Complete output tree: skills/, lint/ (config, package.json, combined config that loads), mappings/ json + removed.md, README.md; only covered rules removed; counts and AGENTS.md consistent.
assertions: Mapping JSON has all required fields for every rule
Every covered/partial toolRuleId exists in the pinned plugin versions (script check)
Fork contains no rule marked covered, and still contains all non-covered rules
Rule counts in the fork's SKILL.md match the remaining rule files
Combined eslint config loads and resolves every rule ID
Final summary states rules removed and size reduction

evals.prompt: Add a second skill to an existing repo: do the split for composition-patterns (<scratch>/upstream/agent-skills/skills/composition-patterns) into a copy of the seed repo (which already contains another skill, demo-skill, that must not be touched except for registering the new config). Approve checkpoints automatically if verification is solid.
evals.expected_output: New skill added; previous skill's files untouched; combined eslint config and package.json merged, README list extended.
assertions: demo-skill files unchanged except the combined config import
Combined eslint config imports both skills
lint/package.json keeps eslint 9.0.0 entry and adds new plugins
Mapping JSON for composition-patterns exists with all fields
